relationships.evidence_quote: Baricitinib also suppressed JAK/STAT3 pathway activity and Csf1 expression in cultured neuronal cells.

relationships.subject: baricitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, only baricitinib decreased the expression of colony-stimulating factor 1 (CSF-1), a potent cytokine that causes neuropathic pain through activation of the microglia-astrocyte axis in the spinal cord.

relationships.subject: baricitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: Only baricitinib treatment significantly inhibited the increase in microglial proliferation induced by CAIA at days 8 and 14 (Fig. 7A).

key_findings: Baricitinib, but not celecoxib, suppressed residual tactile allodynia in CAIA mice and restored DRG gene expression toward control.
Baricitinib reduced DRG Csf1 and spinal microglia/astrocyte increases, likely via IL-6/JAK/STAT3 inhibition in DRG neurons.
